passages.title: Printer delivery
passages.text:
Hana Ito (9:12 A.M.): Hi Marcus, did the new printer arrive yet?
Marcus Webb (9:14 A.M.): It was delivered an hour ago, but the box is still at the reception desk.
Hana Ito (9:15 A.M.): Great. Could you ask Tom to move it to the second-floor copy room?
Marcus Webb (9:18 A.M.): Tom is off today. I can do it after lunch, though.
Hana Ito (9:19 A.M.): That's fine. I just need it set up before the Monday workshop.
Marcus Webb (9:21 A.M.): No problem. I'll also call the supplier about the installation.

why.vi: Marcus nói hộp vẫn nằm ở bàn lễ tân.
why.en: Marcus says the box is still at the reception desk.

questions.trap: Phòng copy là nơi sẽ chuyển tới, chưa phải hiện tại.

questions.q: What will Mr. Webb do after lunch?

why.vi: Tom nghỉ, nên Marcus tự chuyển máy sau bữa trưa.
why.en: Tom is off, so Marcus will move the printer after lunch.

questions.trap: Tom chỉ được nhắc để đề xuất ban đầu; Marcus mới là người làm.

questions.q: At 9:19 A.M., what does Ms. Ito most likely mean when she writes, "That's fine"?
options: She will install the printer herself.

why.vi: Cô chấp nhận việc chuyển máy sau bữa trưa vì chỉ cần xong trước thứ Hai.
why.en: She accepts moving the printer after lunch since she only needs it ready by Monday.

questions.trap: "workshop" là hạn chót, không bị hủy.

passages.title: Saturday shift cover
passages.text:
Lena Ortiz (4:05 P.M.): Reza, are you free to cover my Saturday shift in the gallery? It runs from 8 A.M. to noon.
Reza Amini (4:08 P.M.): Probably. Why do you need someone?
Lena Ortiz (4:09 P.M.): I have a dentist appointment that morning.
Reza Amini (4:12 P.M.): I have a class until 9 on Saturdays, but I could start at 10.
Lena Ortiz (4:13 P.M.): Then I'll ask Priya to take the first two hours. Could you take the last two?
Reza Amini (4:14 P.M.): Sure. Please let the manager know so the schedule is updated.
Lena Ortiz (4:16 P.M.): Will do. Thanks!

questions.q: Why does Ms. Ortiz need a replacement?

why.vi: Lena có hẹn nha sĩ vào sáng thứ Bảy.
why.en: Lena has a dentist appointment that morning.

questions.trap: Lớp học là của Reza, không phải của Lena.

questions.q: When will Mr. Amini most likely work on Saturday?

why.vi: Priya làm hai giờ đầu (8 đến 10), Reza làm hai giờ cuối (10 đến 12).
why.en: Priya takes the first two hours, 8 to 10, and Reza takes the last two, 10 to noon.

questions.trap: Reza có lớp đến 9 giờ nên 8 giờ không thể làm.

questions.q: What will Ms. Ortiz do next?

why.vi: Reza nhờ báo quản lý để cập nhật lịch, và Lena trả lời "Will do".
why.en: Reza asks her to inform the manager, and she answers "Will do".

questions.trap: Cuộc hẹn nha sĩ là lý do nghỉ, không có ý hủy.
